items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Yeah, that was a long before he married you. To Ta Ta Daddy? Yeah.

ctx.x: Huh? Yeah, he came after... you came in when they came in. Yeah, but I came in with God. With God. Yeah. That's how I said. Yeah. See, because on the record we used to record. Yeah.
And it took God's record. Well, yeah, but you see, I mean, after... I left him to go with Sam Morgan and Kimber took my place.
